Lenders reject LAP applications over document and title gaps, not just credit. We get your property paperwork loan-ready so the mortgage sails through.

Key Takeaways

  • A loan against property (LAP) is secured by your property, so lenders scrutinise the title and documents heavily.
  • Most LAP delays and rejections come from document gaps — missing EC, unclear title, pending mutation.
  • We prepare the property side: EC, title verification, valuation and the mortgage documentation.
  • Getting the paperwork right upfront speeds sanction and improves terms.
  • Support for owners and NRIs across Hyderabad and Telangana.

When you raise a loan against property, the lender is really lending against your title. That's why LAP files stall on property issues — a missing link deed, an unclear EC, an incomplete mutation — as often as on credit.

JaaGa gets the property side loan-ready: retrieving the EC, verifying title, arranging valuation and preparing the mortgage documentation the lender needs.

When This Helps

When you plan to raise a loan against a residential, commercial or plot property and want the paperwork to clear smoothly.

When a lender has raised objections on the title, EC or documents that are holding up sanction.

Documents Required

  • Property title deed and link deeds
  • Latest EC (we can retrieve)
  • Property tax / PTIN details
  • Owner identity proof
  • Any lender objection letter

Common Problems We Solve

Unclear title chain

A missing link deed stalls LAP. We trace and complete the chain.

Pending mutation

Lenders want the record in your name. We complete mutation first.

EC / encumbrance doubts

We surface and resolve encumbrance questions before they block sanction.

Why Loan Against Property Matters

A LAP is one of the cheapest ways to borrow — but only if the property paperwork holds up. Fixing title and document gaps before you apply is the difference between a smooth sanction and months of back-and-forth or rejection.

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you provide the loan?

No — JaaGa is not a lender. We prepare and fix the property documentation and title so your LAP application clears smoothly with your bank/NBFC.

What property issues stall LAP?

Unclear title chains, missing EC, pending mutation, encumbrance doubts and valuation gaps are the common culprits.

Can you help after a rejection?

Yes — send us the lender's objections and we resolve the property-side issues behind them.

Do you arrange valuation?

We help arrange a valuation; the lender may also use its own empanelled valuer.

Is this available to NRIs?

Yes, the property documentation work is handled remotely.
